Reaction colour, width and label = pFBA flux at the optimum (Task A medium + PO1f; Gurobi 1e-9). Only the R171 rule differs between the two models; WT fluxes are identical.
R171 before: (14-subunit AND) or g or k; after: 12-subunit AND (ATP6/8/9 + 9 nuclear core subunits). Layout is automatic.
BEFORE (d8d1bac7): alpha subunit YALI1F04433g knocked out. R171 stays open through the single-gene OR branches g / k: growth 0.3117 = WT, fluxes = WT
